mainTitle: 🏛️ State within a State: The Parallel Power of Lusophone Wikipedia
mainDescription: Analysis of the parallel power exercised by the administrative leadership — This article examines how the administrative leadership of Lusophone Wikipedia operates as a "State within a State", applying its own rules, punishments and narratives without external oversight, transforming a democratic platform into an instrument of institutional persecution.
section1Title: 1. Introduction: The Concept of "State within a State"
section1Text1: The term "State within a State" describes a parallel power structure that operates within a larger organization, with autonomy, authority and impunity. In the case of Lusophone Wikipedia, the administrative leadership — composed of administrators, checkusers and bureaucrats — acts as a parallel State, applying its own laws, judging without adversarial proceedings and punishing without appeal.
objective1: • Map the parallel power structure of Lusophone Wikipedia
objective2: • Document the functioning of the "State within a State"
objective3: • Analyze the concentration of power and impunity
objective4: • Examine the erosion of digital democracy
objective5: • Propose measures to dismantle the parallel power
warningCollapseText: Lusophone Wikipedia does not operate as a participatory digital democracy, but as an autocratic regime where a small elite exercises absolute power over the community. The inactivity of the Arbitration Committee (ArbCom), the concentration of power in a few administrators and the absence of external oversight created a "State within a State" that persecutes and silences critical voices.

section3Title: 3. The Digital Aristocracy: The Ruler of the Parallel State
aristocracyCharacteristics: Lifelong power: Administrators have no fixed term and are rarely removed.
Self-selection: New administrators are chosen by existing ones (co-optation).
Exclusive privileges: Access to tools and information not available to the community.
Social isolation: Operate in private channels, outside public scrutiny.
Structural impunity: There are no effective punishment mechanisms for abuses.
Culture of secrecy: Important decisions are made in secret.
Own narrative: They construct versions of facts that favor their interests.

section4Title: 4. The Collapse of the Arbitration Committee (ArbCom)
sub4_1Text1: The Arbitration Committee (ArbCom) was created to be the highest appeal instance and oversight body on Wikipedia. However, in Lusophone, ArbCom is functionally dead:
arbcomDeathList: Chronic inactivity: ArbCom has not judged appeals for years.
Neutralization: It was deliberately weakened by the digital aristocracy.
Vicious composition: ArbCom members are from the same administrative elite.
Complicit silence: Remains inert in the face of serious violations.
Lack of oversight: WMF does not intervene to reactivate ArbCom.
arbcomDeathText: Lusophone Wikipedia's ArbCom is functionally dead. Its inactivity is not accidental — it is the result of a system where administrators do not want to be supervised. ArbCom was neutralized as a control mechanism, allowing the "digital aristocracy" to act with absolute impunity.

section5Title: 5. Control Mechanisms of the Parallel State
sub5_1Text1: The digital aristocracy perpetuates itself through a vicious cycle of self-replication:
step2Text: New administrators are loyal to those who chose them
step3Text: The group isolates itself from the community and criticism
step4Text: The group becomes immune to consequences
step5Text: The group uses power to persecute critics
step7Text: The cycle restarts with more concentrated power
sub5_2Text1: Lusophone Wikipedia suffers from regulatory capture — the regulators (administrators) are captured by the interests they should regulate:
regulatoryCaptureList: Failed self-regulation: Administrators regulate themselves, without external oversight.
Conflict of interest: The same agents who commit abuses also judge them.
Culture of impunity: There are no real consequences for abusive administrators.
Absence of renewal: The same elite maintains power indefinitely.
Informational isolation: The community has no access to internal decisions.
sub5_3Text1: Lusophone Wikipedia's governance structure shows a progressive erosion of digital democracy:

erosionTable.evidence: The community is silenced and intimidated
Decisions are made in closed circles
Administrators do not answer for their actions

paradoxWarningText: Wikipedia presents itself as a model of participatory digital democracy, but the reality of Lusophone is an autocratic regime where a small elite exercises absolute power. This is the central paradox: a platform that should be the epitome of digital democracy has become its most eloquent example of systemic failure.

section7Title: 7. Consequences of the "State within a State"
victimConsequences: Institutional persecution: The parallel power was used to persecute and silence the user.
Permanent damage: The public exposure and SEO damage are irreversible.
Helplessness: The victim has no effective recourse against the parallel power.
Isolation: The community, intimidated, offers no support.
communityConsequences: Silencing: The community is intimidated and does not speak out against abuses.
Loss of trust: The community loses faith in governance mechanisms.
Self-censorship: Users avoid criticizing administrators for fear of reprisals.
Evasion: Users abandon the platform or reduce their participation.
platformConsequences: Legitimacy crisis: Wikipedia loses its credibility as a source of free knowledge.
Reputational damage: The exposure of the parallel State tarnishes the platform's image.
Legal liability: WMF may be held liable for violations of the LGPD and Marco Civil.
Loss of contributions: Persecution drives away valuable collaborators.

section9Title: 9. 📢 Recommendations to Dismantle the Parallel State
immediateReform: ArbCom Reactivation: Immediate appointment of new members with fixed terms and independence.
External members: Inclusion of non-administrator members in ArbCom.
Fixed term: Establishment of maximum terms for administrators (e.g., 2 years).
Radical transparency: Publication of all decisions and justifications.
Demotion of involved agents: Immediate removal of Chronus, Edmond Dantès, Little Sunshine and Johannesn89.
structuralReform: Power decentralization: Distribution of administrative functions among more people.
External oversight: Oversight mechanisms independent from the community.
Mandatory rotation: Administrators must step away periodically.
Direct election: Administrators should be elected by the community, not by co-optation.
External appeal: Creation of independent appeal instance (e.g., WMF with review power).
culturalReform: Ethics training: Mandatory training for all administrators.
Accountability culture: Establishment of clear responsibility standards.
Empathy and respect: Promotion of a culture of respect for the community.
Communicational transparency: Open and honest communication with the community.
Valuing diversity: Inclusion of diverse voices in governance.
section10Title: 10. 📢 Call to Action: End of the Parallel State
callToActionList: Criminal Investigation: Opening of police inquiry to investigate criminal association (Art. 288 of Penal Code).
Civil Investigation: Civil action for moral and material damages against all agents involved.
Administrative Investigation: Inquiry at the Wikimedia Foundation to investigate UCoC violations.
Notification to ANPD: Formal complaint for LGPD violations.
Notification to WMF: Formal communication about ArbCom's collapse and the parallel State.
Structural Reform: Implementation of all proposed recommendations.
Global Demotion: Removal of all involved agents from all administrative positions.
section11Title: 11. Conclusion: The Urgency of Dismantling the Parallel State
finalText1: The WazzimaGiygg case reveals the existence of a "State within a State" in Lusophone Wikipedia — a parallel power structure that operates with autonomy, authority and impunity, persecuting and silencing critical voices.
finalText2: The digital aristocracy — composed of Chronus, Edmond Dantès, Little Sunshine and Johannesn89 — acts as an autocratic regime within the platform, applying its own laws, judging without adversarial proceedings and punishing without appeal.
finalText3: The collapse of ArbCom, regulatory capture and the erosion of digital democracy are not accidents — they are the result of a system that allows administrators to act with absolute impunity.
finalText4: Dismantling the parallel State requires concrete and immediate measures: ArbCom reactivation, demotion of abusive agents, election system reform, implementation of radical transparency and external oversight.
finalText5: Without these reforms, "free knowledge" will continue to be controlled knowledge by a digital aristocracy that uses its power to silence critical voices and destroy reputations.
